properties.areaDesc: Northern Lake Including Gravelly Valley; Eastern Lake Including Clearlake and Middletown; Southern Lake Including Cobb and Konocti
properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued October 16 at 12:55AM PDT until October 16 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* AFFECTED AREA...Fire weather zones 418 including Lake
Pillsbury, 419 including the City of Clearlake, Middletown,
Lower Lake, and Indian Valley Reservoir, and 420 including
Cobb and Mount Konocti.

* WIND...Sustained winds of 15 to 25 mph with gusts to 35 mph
possible in exposed areas.

* HUMIDITY...Low overnight recoveries of 30-35% will drop to
10- 20% through the morning. Very poor RH recovery into
Friday.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will likely spread rapidly.
properties.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions
are either occurring now, or will shortly. A combination of
strong winds, low relative humidity, and warm temperatures can
contribute to extreme fire behavior.

NWSheadline: RED FLAG WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 11 AM PDT THIS MORNING
